flavortext: [Every day, all you make are sweets... Sometimes, I would like to eat something other than cookies.]

title: Cook Club Dir. Jamie

flavortext: [Sita, don't you want to try cooking today? It's our responsibility, after all. It's important to cook something that will bring happiness to the people who eat it.]

effect: Before this card is attacked, if it is active, it gets ATK +1/STA +1.

flavortext: [I made this dish myself! How is it? It doesn't look too bad, right?]

name: Cook Club Linfield
flavortext: [So what if I only make cookies? As long as people like it, then it's good.]

title: Cook Club Marie

title: Cook Club Rookie
name: Cook Club Rookie
flavortext: [Here! It's a rice ball I made myself. So, are you heading to Bamboo Garden?]

title: Cook Club Student
name: Cook Club Student
flavortext: [What a pretty apron! Ever since I was a little girl, I always dreamed of cooking like this!]

title: Cook Club Svia

title: Cook Club Sylphie

title: Cord Ball

effect: If you have at least six cards in your Grave, all cards in your Hand are sent to the bottom of the Deck. If at least three cards were sent, including at least one Follower, a random card in your Grave is sent to the bottom of your Deck, and then this card is removed from the game.
flavortext: [Your magic is channeled through your racket. Without your racket, your magic is useless, isn't it?]

title: Council Casey
name: Council Casey
effect: Before this card attacks, it gets ATK +2, and then this skill is removed.
flavortext: [It isn't touching their skin, so they still aren't obeying the rules! Their bodies need to be told the consequences of breaking the rules.]

title: Council Clerk Fran
name: Council Clerk Fran
flavortext: [Senpai! If you keep doing this, I'm going to reveal all of our minutes to the teachers!]

title: Council Coordinator
name: Council Coordinator
effect: Before this card is attacked, allied Vita Followers get ATK +2, and then this skill is removed.
flavortext: [The event is nearly here. I'm just checking to make sure everything is working as planned. Be sure you're using approved materials and that there are no problems with the food.]

title: Council Dispatch Layna
name: Council Dispatch Layna
effect: Before this card is attacked, it gets ATK +1/STA +2.
flavortext: [Our school is having an event soon, and it's very important. No problems or accidents will be tolerated.]

title: Council Event Inspector
name: Council Event Inspector
effect: Before this card is attacked, it gets STA +1.
flavortext: [I can't make any exceptions. Look over the fireworks budget again and resubmit it.]

title: Council Exec. Maron
name: Council Exec. Maron
effect: Before this card is attacked, if it and the attacker belong to different factions, the attacker gets ATK -1/STA -1 and this card gets ATK +1/STA +1.
flavortext: [Well... This equipment can finally see the light of day again... *cough* Eew. Look at that dust!]

title: Council Justice
name: Council Justice
effect: If you have a Follower with ""Council"" in the name, two random enemy Followers have one of these effects applied depending on the number of allied Vita Followers: ● 1: ATK -2 ● 2: STA -3 ● 3+: ATK -2/DEF -1/STA -2
flavortext: [The heavens call! The earth cries out! The crowds roar... All calling on me to strike back against evil! Now listen up, delinquents! I'm the champion of justice! Student! Council! Inspector!]

effect: At the start of the turn, if your Deck contains a card with "Dress Up Maron" in the name, allied Followers with "Dress Up Maron" in the name are sent to your Grave. flavortext: [I found this sword in the storage room. A manual? "To transform, please perform the following poses in this order..."]

title: Council Pres. Celine
name: Council Pres. Celine
effect: Before this card is attacked, a card in your Hand with "Council" in the name is sent to the top of the Deck, and then this card gets ATK +1/STA +2.
flavortext: [It's no big deal if we go a little over budget, Amy. We can make up for it next semester, so please remember to list my tea costs on the expense report.]

effect:
Before this card attacks, allied Followers with "Council" in the name get ATK +1. 
Before this card is attacked, allied Followers with "Council" in the name get STA +1.

title: Council Press Winfield
name: Council Press Winfield
effect: Before this card attacks, the first card in your Hand with "Council" in the name is sent to the bottom of your Deck, and then this card gets ATK +1/STA +2.
flavortext: [I'm Winfield, from student news. I'm here to take a picture of the president. Is she in a swimsuit? ... Gotta sell that.]

title: Council Roroa
name: Council Roroa
effect: Before this card attacks, the defender's skills are removed until the start of the next turn.
flavortext: [The event is coming soon, so I can't take it easy. I can't lose to my big sister. I have to get everything ready!]

title: Council Student
name: Council Student
effect: Before this card attacks, the first allied Follower with "Council" in the name gets STA +3, and then this skill is removed.
flavortext: [Flowers in my hair? What do you mean? My teacher just said the same thing. She even said something about how she hoped that I would fulfill dreams as beautiful as the flowers in my hair.]

title: Council Suzie
name: Council Suzie
flavortext: [I've got my eye on you. Even if your name isn't listed now, by the end of the month, your name will be on the demerit list.]

title: Council Treas. Amy
name: Council Treas. Amy
effect: Before this card is attacked, allied Followers with "Council" in the name get STA +2, and then this skill is removed.
flavortext: [Don't go over budget this semester. Student council events and compliance with school rules might bring unexpected changes, but no matter what, don't go over budget.]

title: Council VP Tieria
name: Council VP Tieria
effect: Before this card attacks, it gets its ATK/STA increased by 1 plus the number of allied Followers with "Council" in the name. Next, this skill is removed until the start of the next turn.
flavortext: [Celine's support is absolute. I don't know what kind of strategy you have in mind, but it's going to be an uphill battle.]

title: Council Weekly Help
name: Council Weekly Help
effect: Before this card is attacked, its ATK and the attacker's ATK are swapped.
flavortext: [Good morning. What's up, Nanai? What's that magic tool you're holding?]

title: Court Jester
name: Court Jester
effect: If you have at least one Vita Follower with "Council" in the name and at least one Vita Follower without "Council" in the name, two random allied Vita Followers get ATK +3/STA +3.
flavortext: [I just need to use this racket to get the ball into the other side of the court, right? That rule may be set in stone, but I didn't hear anything in the rules about how I'm allowed to do it.]

title: Creepy Witch
name: Creepy Witch
effect: Before this card attacks, if it has a DEF of at least 1, it gets ATK/STA increased by its DEF, and then this skill is removed until the start of the next turn. At the start of the turn, this card gets DEF -1 (to a minimum of 0).
flavortext: [You want to become the center of the alliance? What a big dream. Of course, I like your plan very much. Please bring me some slightly better conditions. I will think about it then.]

title: Crescent Aligote
name: Crescrent Aligote
effect: Before this card is attacked, if it belongs to your Character's faction, the enemy Character gets LIFE -1 and then this skill is removed.
flavortext: Before this card is attacked, if it belongs to your Character's faction, the enemy Character gets LIFE -1 and then this skill is removed.

title: Crescent Conundrum
name: Crescent Conundrum
flavortext: [Everyone's been looking forward to the Flina Family Quiz Convention, and it's finally here! Who will answer these questions? I, Conundrum, as the Crescent representative, will try my best!]

title: Crescent Deviation
name: Crescent Deviation
flavortext: [Stop thinking inside the box. You'll have to think big if you want something new.]

title: Crescent Elder Chenin
name: Crescent Elder Chenin
effect: At the start of the turn, if you have a Darklore Character, the first card in your Hand with "Crescent" in the name and the first Darklore card without "Crescent" in the name are sent to the bottom of your Deck. If this happens, a random enemy Follower is sent to the bottom of the enemy Deck, and then this skill is removed.
flavortext: [Disaster finally came down on our leader, but somehow, I just can't bring myself to care. Moving on, what do you other Elders think about the invasion situation? If Crux wants to bring ruin to our home, we could use this opportunity to have those filthy mixed-bloods shield us, couldn't we?]

title: Crescent Elder Riesling
name: Crescent Elder Riesling
effect: Before this card attacks, it gets ATK +1.
flavortext: [How boring. I have to say I'm disappointed with our leader. We could use some change around here.]

title: Crescent Kris & Con.
name: Crescent Kris & Con.
effect: Before this card is attacked, if you have a Darklore Character, the first two cards in your Hand are sent to the bottom of your Deck. If this happens, a random allied deactivated Follower is reactivated and a random enemy Follower gets SIZE +1/ATK -1/DEF -1.
flavortext: [To be honest, I like you just the way you are, Conundrum.] [... Huh?]

title: Crescent Kris Flina
name: Crescent Kris Flina
flavortext: [Conundrum, when will you stop quizzing yourself? You should at least try to go to the Quiz Convention. Just one time, please? Everyone else is going.]

title: Crescent Maze
name: Crescent Maze
effect: Before this card attacks, if the defender has a DEF of at least 1, the defender gets DEF =0, and then this skill is removed until the start of the next turn.
flavortext: [A box in a box in a box in a box in a box... Looks like the difficulty adjustment failed.]

title: Crescent Muscat
name: Crescent Muscat
flavortext: [I have to get out of here. I've got a bad feeling about this.]

title: Crescent Nazo
name: Crescent Nazo
flavortext: [This is so humiliating. I don't know the answer to a question I made up myself.]

title: Crescent Nyetimber
name: Crescent Nyetimber
flavortext: [Conundrum is still too young. If she tries to take the night quiz, she'll fail. I'm 100% certain. She's just a little girl. Hmph.]

title: Crescent Puzzle
name: Crescent Puzzle
flavortext: [Another piece... More, just a little more... Aah, this is my world.]

title: Crescent Unit Azoth
name: Crescent Unit Azoth
effect: Before this card is attacked, it gets STA increased by the number of allied cards with "Scardel" in the name.
flavortext: [The fighter created by the Crescent elders. With emphasis on independence, she has the ability to cope with any situation. She can even carry out her duties in the light of day.]

title: Crescent Woodbridge
name: Crescent Woodbridge
flavortext: [Ugh... What can I do? Should I ask some vampires...? I don't think I'll get the answer just by sitting here doing nothing.]

title: Crimson Witch Cinia
name: Crimson Witch Cinia
effect: Before this card attacks, the defender gets STA decreased by 1 plus the number of Academy cards in your Hand, and then this card gets STA increased by that same amount.
flavortext: [Tell me. I thought about it constantly, but I still don't understand. Tell me. How could you abandon our sister? Tell me. Do you really love me? Did you really want to kill your own little sister? ... You. I will kill you.]

title: Cross Cut
name: Cross Cut
effect: The last two Crux cards in your Hand are sent to the bottom of your Deck. If this happens, two random enemy Followers are deactivated. If there are any allied cards with "Knight" or "Blue Cross" in the name, those enemy Followers also get STA -2.
flavortext: [Those who can cut are those with the will to cut.]

title: Crux Command
name: Crux Command
effect: One of the following effects is applied depending on the number of cards in your Deck: ● At least 10: Two random allied Followers get DEF +2/STA +1. ● 9 or less: Two random allied Followers get SIZE +1/ATK +6/STA +6.
flavortext: [No need to worry. Heretics will be expelled from this land. The decision has been made. Now go and assemble the knights. I will remove the witches and vampires with my own two hands.]

title: Crux Conference
name: Crux Conference
effect: Two random enemy Followers get ATK -1/STA -3.
flavortext: [Even within Crux, opinions were greatly divided on the plan to deal with the Vampire Lands. However, Jaina's commitment was absolute.]

title: Crux Faithful
name: Crux Faithful
flavortext: [I wanted some time alone to think, so I came early... Unfortunately, I came too early. Why did I come this early?]

title: Crux Knight Fleta
name: Crux Knight Fleta
effect: Before this card is attacked, if it belongs to your Character's faction, allied Crux Followers get ATK +3/STA +3, and then this skill is removed.
flavortext: [Luthica, carry out what you believe is justice. Hesitation will blunt your sword.]

title: Crux Knight Mitil
name: Crux Knight Mitil
flavortext: [No one cares about where I am or what I'm doing. It's like I'm invisible. I never thought that my presence would be helpful to anyone, Miss Luthica.]

title: Crux Knight Pintail
name: Crux Knight Pintail
effect: Before this card is attacked by an enemy Follower with a smaller SIZE, it gets ATK +1/DEF +1.
flavortext: [You, who embrace the night and hunt for blood... are unforgivable!]

title: Crux Knight Sinclair
name: Crux Knight Sinclair
effect: Before this card is attacked, up to two Crux cards in your Grave are removed from the game. Next, this card gets ATK +2/STA +2 and the first other allied Follower gets ATK +1/STA +1.
flavortext: [No worries. The knights are completely different from the church. We'll guarantee your safety. In the meantime, could you tell us about your little sister in more detail?]

title: Crux Knight Terra
name: Crux Knight Terra
flavortext: [No... I don't want to fight any more. Peace... I want to live a peaceful life...]

title: Crux Nemesis Luthica
name: Crux Nemesis Luthica
effect: Before this card attacks, it gets ATK/STA increased by the number of Followers in your Hand. The first Follower in your Hand is sent to the top of your Deck.
flavortext: [Even the air in Crux just feels wrong. I'm going to destroy the whole nation.]

title: Crux Nurse
name: Crux Nurse
flavortext: [Oh, Dr. Kamyu? You... You used to be an OBGYN, didn't you? How did you end up in a place like this...?]

title: Crux Underground
name: Crux Underground
effect: Enemy Followers with the same SIZE as the first enemy card get ATK/STA decreased by the number of enemy cards with the same SIZE as the first enemy card.
flavortext: [GS is prepared. The moment their leader gives the order, they will move as one towards Crux. No one knows the underground labyrinth like they do.]

title: Cultist Maid
name: Cultist Maid
effect: Before this card attacks, the defender's skills are removed. If this happens, this skill is removed.
flavortext: [Before long, everyone in this household will do as I say.]

title: Curious Vernika
name: Wedding Dress Vernika
effect: At the start of the turn, the enemy Follower with the highest DEF gets DEF=0.
flavortext: [Wearing a wedding dress is just like a dream. [[Cinia Pacifica|Cinia]], please give my thanks to [[Linia Pacifica|Linia]].]
notes: This transformation is achieved when Vernika has 100 like and GLAM greater than all other stats.

title: Curse
name: Curse
effect: If you have an Academy Character, two random enemy Followers get ATK -2/STA -2.
flavortext: [The basic principle of curses is to consider your opponent to be weaker than you. Miss Cinia has excellent talent with curses, since she considers everyone in the world to be beneath her.]

title: Curse of Mistrust
name: Curse of Mistrust
effect: The first allied Follower is sent to the bottom of the enemy Deck. If this happens, the first enemy Follower with the highest SIZE that does not belong to the sent Follower's faction is sent to the bottom of your Deck.
flavortext: [I can't trust anyone anymore. If you want to live, get away from me.]

title: Dark Convocation
name: Dark Convocation
effect: A random active allied Darklore Follower is deactivated and gets ATK +3/STA +1. If the Follower has "GS" in the name, it gets an additional STA +2.
flavortext: [Fall in! For world conquest! All hail our great leader! We want punch and pie!]

title: Dark Meeting
name: Dark Meeting
effect: All cards in your Hand are sent to the Grave. If this happens, the first enemy Follower with the highest total ATK/STA gets ATK/STA decreased by 1.5 times the number of sent cards (rounding up).
flavortext: [Today, I wish for all soldiers, as members of the great GS, to continue to battle with excellence!] [Yeah!]

title: Dark Secret
name: Dark Secret

flavortext: [Rose...] [Could you not say anything else for now? I feel so sorry for hiding this from you, my precious sister... But please forgive me.]

title: Defeat

effect: A random allied Academy Follower gets DEF increased by the number of enemy Followers with skills (by a maximum of 3).
flavortext: [Everything has burned away into nothing...]

title: Degradation
name: Degradation
effect: The first two allied Followers without skills get ATK +3/STA +3.
flavortext: [This was the first time the side effects of talentium were seen. In Jaina's letter, she described talentium's true appearance. - Creuset's Experiment Notes]

title: Detection
name: Detection
effect: A random enemy Follower gets STA decreased by its SIZE and gets DEF -1.
flavortext: [Even speed like that can't escape the sight of the Medusa Glasses.]

title: Detective Lady
name: Detective Lady
flavortext: [Examine everything! Don't let a single clue slip through. Lately, there's been something funny about the maids. They must be doing something behind my back... Hmm...]

title: Diligent GIrl

effect: The first two cards in your Deck with "Cinia" in the name are sent to the first two empty Slots in your Hand. If this happens, the first enemy Follower with a STA equal to or less than the total SIZE of the sent cards is sent to the Grave.
flavortext: [Amazing. The artifact even has the power to make Cinia do manual labor. - Esprit's memo]

title: Dispatch Maid
name: Dispatch Maid
effect: Before this card attacks, the defender gets SIZE +1, and then this skill is removed.

effect: If there are any allied Followers, the first enemy Follower gets STA decreased by the ones digit of the difference between the number of cards in your Deck and the enemy Deck.

title: Dollmaster
name: Dollmaster
effect: An enemy Follower in Slot 3 gets ATK/STA decreased by its SIZE.
flavortext: [The dolls just keep coming... Aah! The strings are tangled again! Come on, help me out!]

title: Dollmaster Elfin Rune

effect: Before this card attacks, the defender's skills are removed. If this happens, this skill is removed.
flavortext: [A story of an unlucky girl who makes dolls. A story of the unfortunate girl whose love was stolen by a blonde ghost returned from the dead.]

flavortext: [Big sister... What is the truth? Now... I can't trust anyone. Everything sickens me, even the blood in my veins.]

effect: The first allied Follower with "Council Maron" or "Seeker Smartylane" in the name is sent to your Grave, and then a corresponding card in your Deck with "Dress Up Maron" or "Dress Up Smartylane" in the name is sent to your first empty Slot. That Follower gets SIZE =5/ATK +2/STA +4.
flavortext: [(555) 800-8135...! Change! Dress Up! Shatter the chains of fate!]

title: Dress Up Lucerrie

effect: Before this card attacks, other allied cards with "Dress Up Lucerrie" in the name are sent to the Grave. If any of these effects occur, a random card in the enemy Hand is sent to the Grave.
flavortext: [I am the 753rd master.]

title: Dress Up Maron
name: Dress Up Maron
effect: Before this card attacks, other allied cards with "Dress Up Maron" in the name are sent to your Grave. Next, the first card in your Hand with "Dress Up" in the name is sent to your Grave. If any of these effects occur, the defender gets ATK -1/STA -2.
flavortext: [Heartful Catch! I would be ashamed if I gave up now!]

title: Dress Up Ride
name: Dress Up Ride
effect: If there is an allied Follower with "Dress Up" in the name, the first card in your Deck with "Dress Up" in the name is sent to the first empty Slot in your Field and gets SIZE =5/ATK +3/STA +3.
flavortext: [Who are we? Two vampire detectives who have become one! Dress Up Ride! Tension Fortissimo!]

title: Dress Up Rise
name: Dress Up Rise
effect: If there are any allied Followers with "Dress Up" in the name, a random enemy card is sent to the bottom of the enemy Deck.
flavortext: [No way! Dress... Up... Rise!]

title: Dress Up Sionrion
name: Dress Up Sionrion
effect: Before this card attacks, other allied cards with "Dress Up Sionrion" in the name are sent to the Grave. Next, the first card in your Hand is sent to the bottom of your Deck. If this happens, a random Follower in your Grave with "Sion" or "Rion" in the name is removed from the game. If this happens, the enemy Character gets LIFE -1 and your Character gets LIFE +1.
flavortext: [This is a Talent Memory? It's got weird side effects, but whatever! Now, count up your sins!]

title: Dress Up Smartylane
name: Dress Up Smartylane
effect: Before this card attacks, other allied cards with "Dress Up Smartylane" in the name are sent to your Grave. Next, the first card in your Hand with "Dress Up" in the name is sent to your Grave. If there are no cards in your Hand with "Dress Up" in the name, the first card in your Grave with "Dress Up" in the name is removed from the game. If any of these effects occur, this card gets ATK +1/STA +2.
flavortext: [It even has pre-written speeches for what to say after transforming. Okay... I need to do this. Heartful Catch! I will show you my cry of justice!]

title: Education Results
name: Education Results
effect: The first Crux card in your Hand is sent to your Grave. If this happens, a random allied Crux Follower gets ATK +4/STA +4.
flavortext: [I'm no newbie, girl! No newbie!]

title: El Mundo
name: El Mundo
effect: If you have an Academy Character, a random enemy Follower gets STA decreased by the difference between 8 and this card's SIZE. If this card has a SIZE of less than 3, it gets SIZE +1 and is sent to the first empty Slot in your Hand. If this card has a SIZE of at least 3, it is removed from the game.
flavortext: [There is nothing left to believe in. Hope is useless. People are useless. Everything is useless. Time Stop... Die.]

title: Empowering Chant
name: Empowering Chant
effect: A Follower in Slot 2 gets ATK +2/STA +5. Next, if you do not have a Vita Character, the Follower's skill is removed.
flavortext: [Sita! You can do this!]

title: Encounter

effect: All allied and enemy Spells are sent to the Grave. Two random allied Followers get their ATK/STA increased by 1 plus the number of sent Spells.
flavortext: [Vernika. Why are you standing there like that?] [Sita... Come here.] [I'll bring the old Vernika back. I don't care what this magic sword takes from me, whether it's my eyes or my arms. It can take everything if I can save her.]

title: Enemy Within
name: Enemy Within
effect: Allied Crux Followers with skills have their skills removed. Those Followers get ATK/STA increased by the number of removed skills.
flavortext: [It's what's on the inside that counts. You can't see something that's right under your nose.]

title: Entry Denied
name: Entry Denied
effect: The first allied Follower and the enemy Follower with the highest SIZE are deactivated.
flavortext: [What? Why can't we enter?] [New orders from Crux. No one is allowed to enter the country.]

title: Escape

effect: If there are any allied Followers, all cards in your Hand are sent to the top of your Deck. If this happens, your Character gets LIFE increased by 1.5 times the number of sent cards (rounding up).
flavortext: [Clarice! You're amazing! How did you break me out?] [There is nothing I cannot do! Everything I wish for becomes reality! I did a good job, right Luthica?]

title: Event Preparation

effect: If there are allied Followers that belong to your Character's faction and allied Followers that do not belong to your Character's faction, two random allied Followers get ATK +3/STA +3.
flavortext: [There's going to be such a huuuge crowd. Please follow your orders exactly! You girls will behave, right?]

title: Evil Eye
