effect: If you have a Darklore Character, all enemy Followers get ATK -2/DEF -2/STA -2. If you do not have a Darklore Character, all enemy Followers get ATK -2/DEF -2.
flavortext: [Everything will be drained... Everything this eye sees will die... It doesn't matter if it's friend or foe. It won't show mercy to anyone... Augh... Run!]

title: False Delivery
name: False Delivery
effect: Cards in both Hands that do not belong to the corresponding Character's faction are sent to the Grave.
flavortext: [These three swords were passed down generation to generation in the house of Pacifica. Cinia owns one of them. That sword has the power to change the past. What do you think? Even Jaina has never heard about this.]

title: Fanatic Sarah
name: Fanatic Sarah
effect: Before this card attacks, it gets ATK +2, and then this skill is removed.
flavortext: [This is a sign of obsession. She's obsessed with glasses. She even has a pair of sleeping glasses.]

title: Fast Forward
name: Fast Forward
effect: All Crux Followers in your Hand are sent to the Grave. If this happens, the last allied Follower gets ATK/STA increased by twice the number of sent cards.
flavortext: [The chrono clock's true power is to grant acceleration. This power, "Clock Up", allows its user's speed to exceed the limits of the human body for ten seconds.]

title: Fatal Blow
name: Fatal Blow
effect: All allied and enemy cards with a SIZE less than or equal to the number of cards in your Hand and Field are sent to the owners' Graves. Your Character gets LIFE decreased by the number of sent cards.
flavortext: [Be warned. Some day, you will pay for this.]

title: Fated Rival Seven
name: Fated Rival Seven
effect: Before this card attacks, up to two Academy cards in your Grave are removed from the game. If this happens, two random enemy Followers get ATK -1/DEF -1/STA -2.
flavortext: [You said your name was Nanai, right? I expected more from you. Remember this. Next time, I won't lose.]

title: Fault
name: Fault
effect: If there are at least two allied Followers with "Tennis" in the name, the enemy Character gets LIFE -3.
flavortext: [Fault! Rhona's serve has failed! The nationals are coming down to this! This is a crisis for Rhona!]

title: Feast
name: Feast
effect: If your Character has "Sita" in the name, it gets LIFE +4.
flavortext: [Vernika, Vernika... These... Can I eat them all?]

title: Final Answer
name: Final Answer
effect: If you have a Darklore Character, the first enemy Follower with the highest sum of ATK and STA gets SIZE/ATK/STA decreased by the number of cards in both Hands (to a minimum SIZE of 1).
flavortext: [This long-awaited final question has been the most difficult question for three generations of Crescents. Will Conundrum figure out the answer?]

title: Flag Knight Frett
name: Flag Knight Frett
effect: Before this card attacks, an allied Follower in Slot 3 gets ATK +1/STA +1.
flavortext: [May I plant this here? Ah, no matter how many times I look at it, there's no flag more beautiful than that of Crux. Isn't that right, Luthica-senpai?]

title: Flina's Command
name: Flina's Command
effect: Two random allied Darklore Followers get STA +3.
flavortext: [Members of the Flina family, Master Luna Flina's words are absolute. Every sentence she utters carries as much power as a spell.]

title: Forced Confinement
name: Forced Confinement
effect: If you have a Darklore Character, the enemy Follower with the highest STA is sent to the bottom of the enemy Deck. Your Character gets LIFE decreased by half of the sent card's SIZE (rounding up).
flavortext: [Wasn't it decided that we would unite, since it's impossible to co-exist with the light? Why are you so scared of yourselves and the existence of others?]

title: Forced Entry
name: Forced Entry
effect: Compare the SIZE of the cards in Slot 3 in both Fields. The card with the smaller SIZE is destroyed. If both cards are the same SIZE, the card in Slot 3 of the enemy's Field is sent to the Grave.
flavortext: [We saw the Scarlet Mage just as he got off the stairs. The entrance to the ruins lay just beyond. Everyone, including myself, was suddenly struck down. There was a flash of light and a crack of thunder, then only pain... We were helpless.]

title: Fortune Lady
name: Fortune Lady
effect: Before this card attacks, a random card in your Grave is removed from the game. If this happens, a random card in your Grave is sent to the bottom of your Deck.
flavortext: [Throw me some coins, cute lady?]

title: Full Moon Power
name: Full Moon Power
effect: Allied Followers with "Crescent", "Scardel", or "Flina" in the name get ATK +3.
flavortext: [When the full moon rises, there will be perfect harmony between the moon and the power of darkness.]

title: GS 1st Star
name: GS 1st Star
effect: Before this card is attacked, if it and the attacker belong to different factions, the attacker gets ATK -1/STA -1 and this card gets ATK +1/STA +1.
flavortext: [In the GS, there are 9 Stars in all. I am the first of them. If we are successful in rooting ourselves within Crux, the 2nd Star will come looking for us.]

title: GS Agent
name: GS Agent
effect: Before defending, the first card in your deck with "GS" in the name is moved to the first empty slot of your field, then this ability is removed.
flavortext: [For the glory of the great GS! I've completed my duties! What's my next assignment? Am I going to the Crux nation?]

title: GS Alla Marcia
name: GS Alla Marcia
effect: Before this card is attacked, the first card in your Deck with "GS Soldier" in the name is sent to your first empty Slot, gets ATK +2, and is deactivated. Next, this skill is removed until the start of the next turn.
flavortext: [Soldiers, take pride. By fighting at our sides, your strength will grow. We were once like you, but the day will come when you fulfill your potential.]

title: GS Fighting Instructor
name: GS Fighting Instructor
effect: At the start of the turn, allied Followers with ""GS"" in the name get ATK +1/STA +1 and allied Followers without ""GS"" in the name get ATK =-1/STA -1.
flavortext: [This is my 2nd year with the GS. I will destroy everything before me.]

title: GS Recon
name: GS Recon
effect: Before this card attacks, the defender gets SIZE +1, and then this skill is removed.
flavortext: [This is dangerous... If we want their continued support, we should learn more about them first.]

title: GS Soldier
name: GS Soldier
flavortext: [In the name of GS! For punch and pie!]

title: GS Spy
name: GS Spy
effect: Before this card is attacked, if it is active, it gets ATK +1/STA +1.
flavortext: [Ouch, my muffler suddenly came off. Was I... caught?]

title: Game Starter
name: Game Starter
flavortext: [This is the first step. Never forget how you feel at this moment.]

title: Gardening Maid
name: Gardening Maid
flavortext: [Miss Cinia, the head maid left a message for you. She said that lunch is ready... What? Precious Pet #2 is lost? Yes, I am responsible for the garden...It's Rosa's pet, so I don't know anything about it, but I will do my best to find it.]

title: Gart
name: {{PAGENAME
effect: At the start of the turn, a random enemy Follower that is not from this card's faction gets ATK -2/STA -2. If this card and all enemy Followers belong to the same faction, two random enemy Followers get STA -1.
flavortext: [I just don't like Nold! It- It's not like I think your uniform is cute or anything, so don't get any ideas! It's not like I wanted to wear it!]
notes:
Reward for beating [[Advanced Dungeon]] 10 times
See also: [[Star Bird Gart]].

title: Genius Student Nanai
name: Genius Student Nanai
effect: Before this card is attacked, all cards in both Graves with the same SIZE as the attacker are removed from the game. The attacker's ATK/STA are decreased by the number of removed cards.
flavortext: [Tell me anything, Celine-senpai. There's nothing I can't handle. I've been aware of all the world's grand truths since I was 10, so please trust me.]
notes: This card is currently bugged. It should read: Before this card is attacked, remove all the cards with an equal SIZE to the attacker's card from the graveyard. Reduce attacker's ATK/STA by the number of removed cards.

title: Ginger
name: {{PAGENAME
effect: At the start of the turn, allied Followers with a SIZE equal to or greater than the number of allied cards get ATK +1/STA +2.
flavortext: [What? Do you have an issue? That guy's already caused me a ton of trouble. I don't care anymore. You beat me, so do whatever you want with me.]
notes: See also: [[Twilight Wolf Ginger]].

title: Glasses
name: Glasses
flavortext: [Talentium has made its way into everyday life. The metal is very easy to process, so people put talentium into just about anything. - Esprit's Memo]

title: Golden Pair
name: Golden Pair
effect: If there are at least two allied Followers with the same name, the first set of matching Followers get ATK +3/STA +3.
flavortext: [We're the Golden Pair that will lead Vita to the nationals! Off to the nationals!]

title: Good Job
name: Good Job
effect: All allied and enemy Followers get ATK +1.
flavortext: [Sita, we have to thank everyone for their hard work. Please repeat after me. Good job!]
notes: This card is only obtainable from the Deluxe Starter Set.

title: Green Ore
name: Green Ore
flavortext: [Talentium is known to vary in color. In some places, you can find green talentium. If you want to get some talentium, the Poaching Bureau recently discovered that talentium can be found in the bodies of monsters. - Esprit's Memo]

title: Guard Maid
name: Guard Maid
effect: At the start of the turn, a random Follower with "Maid" in the name gets ATK +1/STA +1
flavortext: [I'm committed to the safety of Ms. Cinia.] [You should also be committed to the safety of my furniture, as well as my pottery.]

title: Guide Rio
name: Guide Rio
effect: Before this card attacks, it gets ATK +1~3 (Randomly). Before this card is attacked, it gets STA +1~3 (Randomly).
flavortext: [It's been a long time since I last guided you through the dungeon. How are you doing? Are you afraid? Don't worry.]
notes: This card is only obtainable from Episode 0 boosters.

title: Halloween Countess
name: Halloween Countess
effect:
If there are any allied Followers and there are any enemy Followers with skills, a copy of the first Spell in the enemy Hand without ""Halloween"" in the name is created in the first empty Slot in your Field, and then a random enemy Follower with a skill has its first skill removed and it gets one of the following skills randomly:
● Before this card attacks, it gets ATK -1.
● Before this card is attacked, it gets STA -3.
flavortext: [Perfect! Okay... Now stick out your tongue like you're licking off some blood!]

title: Halloween Minidevil
name: Halloween Minidevil
effect: A random enemy Follower gets STA decreased by the ATK of the first Follower in your Hand. If this happens, a copy of the first Spell in the enemy Hand without "Halloween" in the name is created in the first empty Slot in your Field.
flavortext: [Alright. Look over here! Good. Raise your eyes a little. Tres magnifique! Perfect! Let's go! Fashion Queen!] [Vernika, I wanna eat it! Hurry up.]

title: Halloween Witch
name: Halloween Witch
effect:
A random allied Follower gets one of the following skills (If this happens, a copy of the first Spell in the enemy Hand without ""Halloween"" in the name is created in the first empty Slot in your Field.):
● Before this card attacks, it gets ATK +1/STA +1.
● Before this card is attacked, it gets STA +3.
● At the start of the turn, this card gets DEF +2.
flavortext: [Amazing. Just by adding a broom...] [Jaina?]

title: Head Knight Jaina
name: {{PAGENAME
effect: At the start of the turn, a random allied Follower gets ATK +2. If the Turn Number is even, the Follower gets an additional STA +1.
flavortext: [Being the head knight is a massive responsibility. I must ensure that everything goes according to plan, so I operate under a lot of stress. Sometimes, I feel like I need to take a break.]

title: Head Maid
name: Head Maid
flavortext: [Uh... So.... Why should I be in charge of managing the vacations and salaries of all of Cinia's maids?]

title: Healing Magic
name: Healing Magic
effect: Your Character gets LIFE increased by the number of cards in your Hand.
flavortext: [The basic principle of healing magic is to have a strong will. Picture something you want to protect, then cast the spell.]

title: Heart Stone
name: Heart Stone
flavortext: [A witch's mana can only be used by witches. It can't leave the body by itself, so witches make artifacts like these. These witches' hearts, which connect a witch's magic to the world's mana, are called heart stones.-Esprit Memo]

title: Heart Stone Witch
name: Heart Stone Witch
effect: Before this card is attacked, allied Followers with "Witch" in the name get ATK +2/STA +2, and then this skill is removed.
flavortext: [This is a tool for the study of witch magic, a heart stone, also known as the treasure of the sages. I just want to live a life of freedom. That's all. Get ready. Refuse to be bound by limits. Open the control circuit. Wipe out all enemies before you!]

title: Heartless Blow
name: Heartless Blow
effect: A random enemy Follower gets STA -4. Next, if your character has “Sita” in the name, a random enemy Follower gets STA -2.
flavortext: [I don’t think Sita has an ounce of mercy in her. She’s just going to chop its head off while it’s staring her in the eye like it’s nothing. How can she be so cutthroat?] [... It's just a fish.]

title: Holy Beast Tear
name: Holy Beast Tear
flavortext: [This Material can be found in the Crux Training Camp Dungeon.] [These Holy Beast Tears are the most important component of the epaulets that signify knighthood. Even the name sounds sacred. However, when you watch that girl as her tears fall, it's questionable if she can really be considered "Holy." - Esprit's Memo]
notes:
Found in [[Crux Training Dungeon]]
Used to craft Episode 3 cards.

title: Home Study
name: Home Study
effect: All Followers in your Hand get ATK/STA increased by 1 plus the number of cards in your Hand and Grave with the same name as this card.
flavortext: [Cinia, it is important to consider how others feel. How would you feel if you were in your servants' shoes?]

title: Hot Item
name: Hot Item
effect: All allied Followers get ATK +2/STA +3.
flavortext: [Vita Public High School official merchandise. A cute keychain featuring the principal.]

title: Hot Springs Cinia
name: Hot Springs Cinia
effect: At the start of the turn, a random enemy Follower has one of the following effects applied depending on its DEF: ● 1 or greater: DEF -1/ STA -1 ● 0 or less: ATK -2/STA -2
flavortext: [How quaint! This is quite different from the mansion's bathrooms. Excellent. I didn't come in vain.]

title: Hot Springs Iri
name: Hot Springs Iri
effect: At the start of the turn, if an enemy Follower has at least 10 STA, that enemy Follower gets STA -4. If all enemy Followers have less than 10 STA, a random enemy Follower gets ATK -1/DEF -1/STA -1.
flavortext: [The times I spent with my mother in this hot spring made me so happy. I wish I could go back to those days...]

title: Hot Springs Luthica
name: Hot Springs Luthica
effect: At the start of the turn, a random allied Follower has one of the following effects applied depending on its DEF: ● 1 or greater: ATK +2/ STA +2 ● 0 or less: DEF +1/STA +1
flavortext: [D-Don't stare at me like that... It's embarrassing.]

title: Hot Springs Sita
name: Hot Springs Sita
effect: At the start of the turn, enemy Followers in Slots 2, 3, and 4 get STA -2, and a random enemy Follower gets STA -1.
flavortext: [Who's there? I sense someone...]

title: Impulse
name: Impulse
effect: If you have a Darklore Character, your Character gets LIFE -1. If this happens, a random enemy Follower gets STA -5. Next, if there are least eight cards in your Grave, a random enemy Follower gets STA -5.
flavortext: [In that moment, my mind went blank. Even though I had the strength to stand before the Elders, my will shattered. The only thing left of me was another self, driven by a terrible thirst and loneliness.]

title: Inevitable Choice
name: Inevitable Choice
effect: If you have an Academy Character, the first allied Academy Follower gets ATK/STA increased by the number of allied Academy cards and gets SIZE decreased by the number of allied cards with "Lady" in the name.
flavortext: [With her hatred, Cinia's power grew enormously. Finally, she made her decision. Her spirit was dominated.]

title: Infighting
name: Infighting
effect: If there are any allied Followers, allied Followers that belong to the first allied Follower's faction are sent to the Grave. If this happens, enemy Followers that belong to the first enemy Follower's faction, except for the first enemy Follower, are sent to the Grave. This card is removed from the game.
flavortext: [You're always like this, President! Everything has to go your way! You never listen to what we have to say!]

title: Inhuman Creature
name: Inhuman Creature
effect: If there are Followers in both Fields, a random allied Follower and a random enemy Follower are sent to the Grave.
flavortext: [R...Roach!] [Stay still, Vernika.]

title: Inscribing Magician
name: Inscribing Magician
flavortext: [This place is activated by casting a particular spell. When you pass by, don't stay quiet. Silence is the key that starts that spell.]

title: Insomniac Nanasid
name: Insomniac Nanasid
effect: Before this card is attacked, it gets ATK +2/DEF -1. The attacker gets ATK -2, and then this skill is removed.
flavortext: [Her eyes start to open because of a strange voice, but when her eyes are open, no sound can be heard. This cycle repeats itself over and over again. It's said that when her eyes are closed, she can see something.]

title: Inspiration Lady
name: Inspiration Lady
flavortext: [I feel an omen that something will fall from here tomorrow. Someone will fall from this high place. You... You're a real Crux Knight, right?]

title: Intrusion
name: Intrusion
effect: Two random allied Followers get STA +3. If this happens, cards are sent from the enemy Deck to the enemy Hand until the enemy Hand is full.
flavortext: [At the very moment when Conundrum chose her answer, a voice cried out. "Hold it!"]

title: Iri Flina
name: Iri Flina
effect: At the start of the turn, if your Field's SIZE is larger than the enemy's total SIZE the enemy's Character card Loses LIFE -1.
flavortext: [This isn't right. Even though the Scardels and the Crescents are older than you, they shouldn't be ordering you around like this. If you don't like me, then have the decency to tell it to my face... Those cowards hide behind their age and status]

title: Justice Lady
name: Justice Lady
effect: At the start of the turn, the first card in your Deck with "Dress Up Lucerrie" in the name is sent to your first empty Slot. If this happens, this card is sent to the Grave, and that Follower gets SIZE =5/ATK +3/STA +2.
flavortext: [I don't want to watch my friends' tears! Instead, you should watch! My! Transformation!]

title: Keepsake
name: Keepsake
effect: The second allied Follower gets ATK/DEF/STA increased by the first allied Follower's SIZE. If this happens, and if you have a Vita Character, the first allied Follower is sent to the bottom of your Deck. If you do not have a Vita Character, the first allied Follower is sent to the Grave.
flavortext: [Vernika was nowhere in the ruins of the buildings. Sita searched for a long time, but the all she could find were her glasses.]

title: Knight Adjt. Sarisen
name: Knight Adjt. Sarisen
effect: At the start of the turn, other Followers with "Knight" in the name get ATK +1/STA +1.
flavortext: [Don't think that it'll be difficult to weaken the vampires. You just need to eliminate their leader. Just concentrate on locating her, Luthica.]

title: Knight Escort
name: Knight Escort
flavortext: [Ugh... How much longer until my shift is over?]

title: Knight Frett & Pintail
name: Knight Frett & Pintail
effect: Before this card is attacked, if you have a Crux Character, the first two cards in your Hand are sent to the bottom of your Deck. If this happens, a random allied deactivated Follower is reactivated and a random allied Follower gets SIZE -1/ATK +1/STA +2.
flavortext: [Did you just laugh at me?] [I just can't let it drop, senpai.] [You just laughed at me about being in a slump, didn't you?]

title: Knight's Letter
name: Knight's Letter
effect: If your Field and the enemy Field contain the same number of cards, two random enemy cards are sent to the bottom of the enemy Deck.
flavortext: [There is something strange about all these countries closing their borders. It's like someone trying to dam up every branch in a river... Please deliver this letter to the Empire immediately.]

title: Kouhai
name: Kouhai
flavortext: Description: [Vernika-senpai! Are you going there? Can you take me with you? I want to see that monster you were talking about with my own eyes!]

title: Lady's Attendant
name: Lady's Attendant
effect: Two random allied Academy Followers get their ATK increased by the number of cards in your Hand and get their STA increased by 1 plus the number of cards in the enemy Hand.
flavortext: [Keep the skirt free of wrinkles. Make sure the lace doesn't flutter. Calmly maintaining a lady's appearance is an attendant's basic responsibility.]

title: Lady's Wrath
name: Lady's Wrath
effect: The last Academy card in your Hand is sent to the Grave. If this happens, a random enemy Follower gets ATK -4/STA -4.
flavortext: [What the... How?! How did this happen?!]

title: Laevateinn
name: {{PAGENAME
effect: At the start of the turn, if your hand has two or more cards of the same SIZE, you get LIFE equal to half that size (rounded up).
flavortext: [How do you like it? As long as it's in your dreams, I can do anything for you. I can be anything for you. The girl you have a one-sided crush on, the woman of your dreams... You just need to sleep to have her in bed with you.]
notes: See also: [[Flame Laevateinn]].

title: Lago de Cisnes
name: Lago de Cisnes
effect: All enemy Followers with the highest combined ATK/STA get their ATK/STA halved (rounding up). If your Character has "Iri" in the name, those Followers get an additional ATK -2/DEF -2/STA -2.
flavortext: [A single slash that destroys the silence.]

title: Lancer Knight
name: Lancer Knight
effect: Before this card attacks, a random card in your Grave is removed from the game. If this happens, a random card in your Grave is sent to the bottom of your Deck.
flavortext: [The moment this spear pierces, the results will be set in stone. You will lose and I will win. This has already been decided.]

title: Lantern Witch
name: Lantern Witch
effect: Before this card attacks, it gets DEF =0, and its ATK/STA are raised by the difference between this card's DEF and the defender's DEF (to a maximum of 9).
flavortext: [Places like this rarely get visitors. You said your name was Asmis? The place you're looking for is nearby, but it's also beyond your reach.]

title: Latecomer
name: Latecomer
flavortext: [Late students all look the same when you imagine them. They all run to school with a slice of toast in their mouths. You might say it's only a stereotype, but...]

title: Layna Scentriver
name: Layna Scentriver
effect: At the start of the turn, a random allied Vita Follower gets ATK +1/STA +1.
flavortext: [Come over here. If you are avoiding me just because I have been demanding, I will be very upset.]

title: Lib. Ace
name: Lib. Ace
effect: At the start of the turn, allied Vita Followers have their ATK/STA increased by this card's SIZE.
flavortext: [A book about the land of Kana? I can find any book I want. I'm the best library researcher in the world. Trust me, senpai.]

title: Lib. Advisor
name: Lib. Advisor
effect: Before this card attacks, all cards in your Deck with the same name as this card are removed from the game. For each card removed, this card gets ATK +1/DEF +1/STA +2.
flavortext: [I don't deny every student request, but you should really rethink your list of book requests, Serie.]

title: Lib. Daisy
name: Lib. Daisy
effect: Before this card attacks, if the defender has a DEF of at least 1, the defender gets DEF =0, and then this skill is removed until the start of the next turn.
flavortext: [Ow! Senpai! You can't buy every mysterious book! I wouldn't want these even as a donation! Please don't play pranks like this again!]

title: Lib. Evenne
name: Lib. Evenne
effect: Before this card is attacked, if it belongs to your Character's faction, the enemy Character gets LIFE -1 and then this skill is removed.
flavortext: [I'm reading. Tell me later. Don't bother me.]

title: Lib. H.L. Tezina
name: Lib. H.L. Tezina
effect: At the start of the turn, if you have a Vita Character, a Vita card with "Lib." in the name and a Vita card without "Lib." in the name are sent from your Hand to the bottom of your Deck. If this happens, a random enemy card is sent to the bottom of the enemy Deck, and then this skill is removed.
flavortext: [I'm the Library Club's number one member! I left the title of Search King to my kouhai so I could take a break, but I'm finally back! I'm the Hyper Librarian! Tezina!]

title: Lib. Lilith
name: Lib. Lilith
flavortext: [The library is closed for archival. Could you come later?]

title: Lib. Lindt
name: Lib. Lindt
flavortext: [People who don't return books ought to be warned. Huh? What's this book?]
history: Update 2.2.2: Name changed from Librarian Lindt to Library Lindt.

title: Lib. Lotte & Serie
name: Lib. Lotte & Serie
effect: Before this card is attacked, if you have a Vita Character, the first two cards in your Hand are sent to the bottom of your Deck. If this happens, a random deactivated allied Follower is reactivated and a random allied Follower gets SIZE -1/ATK +1/DEF +1.
flavortext: [Serie, I have to apologize. That cobalt book was pretty good after all. Sorry, Serie. We're still friends, right?]

title: Lib. Lucca
name: Lib. Lucca
flavortext: [Vernika-senpai! Don't just sit there and read. Help us sort out the books too! How much extra work do you want to pile on this cute little kouhai?]
history: Update 2.2.2: Name changed from Librarian Lucca to Library Lucca

title: Lib. Lucca(Ep5)
name: Lib. Lucca
flavortext: [I practiced a lot at home, but I'm still nervous, senpai...]

title: Lib. Manager Lotte
name: Lib. Manager Lotte
effect: Before this card attacks, the defender's skills are removed. If this happens, this skill is removed.
flavortext: [Listen, Serie. Someone put those weird books on the book request list, and it was either you or Lindt. I'm going to reject these, alright? That "Glass Library" publisher was weird to begin with. From now on, any cobalt blue books are going to be rejected. If anyone wants to read them, they should buy them with their own money.]

title: Lib. Milka
name: Lib. Milka
effect: At the start of the turn, a random allied Follower with "Lib." in the name gets STA +2.
flavortext: [The book will be due next week. Please remember to return it.]
history: Update 2.2.2: Name changed from Library Member Milka to Library Milka.

title: Lib. Milka(Ep5)
name: Lib. Milka
effect: Before this card is attacked, the first allied Follower with "Lib." in the name gets STA +2. This skill is removed until the start of the next turn.
flavortext: [It's alright. Don't worry. All we need is chemistry!

title: Lib. Milty
name: Lib. Milty
effect: Before this card attacks, it has its STA increased by the number of cards in your Hand with "Lib." in the name. If its STA is increased by at least three, it also gets ATK +1.
flavortext: [I joined the Library Club because my sister did, but I don't know about this... Can I really help?]

title: Lib. Serie
name: Lib. Serie
effect: Before this card attacks, its ATK is increased by the number of cards in your Hand with "Lib." in the name.
flavortext: [Vernika... Hasn't she been spending too much time in the Cooking Club lately? She needs a warning...]
history: Update 2.2.2: Name changed from Librarian Serie to Library Serie.

title: Lib. Student
name: Lib. Student
effect: Before this card attacks, the defender gets SIZE +1, and then this skill is removed.
flavortext: [I love to read quietly by myself. What? Tearing through books? I'd never do that... What are you talking about?]

title: Lib. Vernika
name: Lib. Vernika
effect: Before this card is attacked, it gets STA +2.
flavortext: [The world of books really is without limits. Do you read often, Sita?]
history: Update 2.2.2: Name changed from Librarian Vernika to Library Vernika.

title: Lightning Witch
name: Lightning Witch
effect: At the start of the turn, this card gets SIZE -2 or SIZE +1. (50% chance)
flavortext: [I respect your goal and will. However, I prefer my own freedom. Sorry, but I'll have to reject your offer, witch queen.]

title: Lily
name: Lily
flavortext: [This flower is a symbol of the Pacifica family. You can find it in any Pacifica household. It's funny because it really suits them. - Esprit's Memo]
notes:
Found in [[Linia's Mansion]]
Used to craft Episode 4 cards.

title: Lineage Maintenance
name: Lineage Maintenance
effect: Allied Academy Followers with a Slot number equal to their SIZE get ATK +3/STA +3.
flavortext: [They were always worried about how to preserve their superior bloodline... And this was their solution. Unfortunately, the results were disastrous. No more sons would ever be born.]

title: Linia Pacifica
name: Linia Pacifica
effect: At the start of the turn, this card and adjacent Academy Followers have their ATK/STA increased by half of this card's SIZE (rounding up).
flavortext: [Cinia. Rose's story was tragic, but it's time to move forward. Can you do that? Cheer up.]

title: Linia's Tastes
name: Linia's Tastes
effect: If you have any Followers in your Field, a random enemy Follower is sent to the Grave. If this happens, and this card has a SIZE of at least 2, a copy of this card is created in the first empty Slot in the enemy Field, gets SIZE -1, and is then deactivated.
flavortext: [Sorry, Miss Linia... I'm always making mistakes.] [No problem. Things will be just fine. You can fix it later, but how about spending some time with me first? I miss having company.]

title: Lost Doll
name: Lost Doll
effect: Before this card is attacked, it gets STA +2.
flavortext: [The third story is of a doll with dreams that could never be realized. A story of an unfortunate girl who forgot that no matter how big a puppy grows, it's still only a dog.]

title: Low Turnout
name: Low Turnout
effect: The allied Vita Follower with the highest DEF gets STA increased by twice its DEF. The first Vita card in your Hand is sent to the bottom of your Deck.
flavortext: [The vote to impeach Celine happened to coincide with the festival, so there was a low voter turnout. Nanai missed out on the opportunity of a lifetime.]

title: Luna Flina
name: Luna Flina
effect: Before this card attacks, if there are at least two allied Darklore cards, the defender gets ATK -1/DEF -2/STA -1.
flavortext: [What are the elders trying to do? You can't just move however you want. I need to investigate more.]

title: Lunia Scentriver
name: Lunia Scentriver
effect: Before this card attacks, it gets copies of the defender's first two skills. If this happens, this card gets ATK/STA increased by the number of gained skills.
flavortext: [There's something happening in Crux. Layna, could you take care of mother while I'm out? I think this is worth seeing.]

title: Luthica Preventer
name: Luthica Preventer
effect: At the start of the turn, a random Crux Follower gets ATK +1/STA +1
flavortext: [When I needed help, Jaina was there. I would like to repay the favor to both her and you, her knights. Wherever I go, I will lead the charge. Rest assured and focus on your fights.]

title: Luthica's Suit
name: Luthica's Suit
effect: Two random allied Crux Followers get ATK +2/STA +2. Two random allied Followers with "Luthica" in the name get ATK +1/STA +1.
flavortext: [Just like I thought. Luthica's proportions are perfect. This should be good enough to compete. Fashion Queen...] [What?]

title: Luthica's Ward
name: {{PAGENAME
effect: Up to three Crux cards in your Grave are removed from the game. If this happens, two random allied Crux Followers get ATK/STA increased by 2 plus the number of removed cards.
flavortext: [I'll use my power to create an opening! Take that opportunity and attack the monster with everything you've got!]

title: Magic Circle Witch
name: Magic Circle Witch
effect: Before this card attacks, a random card in your Grave is removed from the game. If this happens, a random card in your Grave is sent to the bottom of your Deck.
flavortext: [I'll end my life as a maid with this. Completing this magic circle is the first step to freedom.]

title: Magic Society Invite
name: Magic Society Invite
effect: The second Academy follower gets same DEF/STA as the follower in Slot 1.
flavortext: [The Academy sent us an invitation to the Magic Society. Sita, Vernika, you girls are kind of famous. If you're interested, let's go together.]

title: Magic Stone Found
name: Magic Stone Found
effect: The first Academy card in your Hand is sent to the Grave. Two random enemy Followers get ATK -1/DEF -2.
flavortext: [The magic stone of the Mother Demon has been discovered.]

title: Magic Teacher
name: Magic Teacher
flavortext: [Listen, class. The basic principle of all magic is to understand the structure of the spell you need. Never forget this. To make sure you remember this, there's going to be a test tomorrow.]

title: Maid Experience
name: Maid Experience
effect: All cards in your Hand and Grave with the name "[[Home Study]]" are removed from the game. Two random enemy Followers get STA decreased by twice the number of removed cards.
flavortext: [Miss Cinia, please react more quickly!] [You... Do not expect to be forgiven tomorrow!]

title: Maid Revolution
name: Maid Revolution
effect: If you have at least one Academy Follower with "Maid" in the name and at least one Academy Follower without "Maid" in the name, two random Academy Followers get ATK +3/STA +3.
flavortext: [Comply with legal working hours! Raise our salaries! Give us at least one day of paid time off per month!]

title: Marionette
name: Marionette
effect: The first allied Follower gets ATK/STA changed to equal half of its total ATK/STA (rounding up).
flavortext: [You may make me move any way you wish. However, do not approach. Use your eyes only.]

title: Marksman Knight
name: Marksman Knight
flavortext: [Goddess, I am depending on you. I entrust myself to you completely. Use me to defeat our foes. Amen.]

title: Mass Recall
name: Mass Recall
effect: All enemy cards with a SIZE of 3 or less, as well as all non-Academy cards in your Field, are sent to the Grave.
flavortext: [Let's go back. The tea and cookies are ready. Tea time!]

title: Master Luna Flina
name: Master Luna Flina
effect: Before this card is attacked, it gets DEF changed to equal to the number of allied Darklore cards and gets STA increased by the same amount.
flavortext: [This is not the time to judge Iri Flina. By withholding judgment, I will protect her for a while longer. The Elders are too arbitrary, so I will handle this by myself.]

title: Maximum Drive
name: Maximum Drive
effect: The first allied Follower is sent to the Grave. An enemy card with a Slot number equal to the sent card's SIZE is sent to the Grave.
flavortext: [You have two hours, thirty-seven minutes, and thirty-five seconds to resolve today's incident. Despair waits for you at the finish line.]

title: Meadow Leisure
name: Meadow Leisure
effect: A random allied Follower gets ATK increased by the number of allied cards minus 1 and gets STA increased by 1 plus the number of allied cards.
flavortext: [We're only able to relax and enjoy life thanks to the hard work of the knights. Never forget all the effort it took to win this peace.]

title: Mediator Cabernet
name: Mediator Cabernet
effect: At the start of the turn, allied Darklore Followers get ATK+2/STA+2.
flavortext: [Don't always think about fighting. It falls on me to arbitrate fights between allies.]

title: Medic Knight
name: Medic Knight
effect: At the start of the turn, the first card in the enemy Deck is sent to the Grave, and then this card gets STA +2.
flavortext: [Kamyu, don't worry too much about my uniform. It's a service for the patients. ♡]

title: Medusa Glasses
name: Medusa Glasses
effect: All enemy Followers get ATK -1. A random allied Vita Follower gets its STA increased by the combined ATK reduction.
flavortext: [These magic lenses, the Medusa Glasses, augment the user's visual perception greatly; They can even grab arrows out of the air with their bare hands.]

title: Meeting Master
name: Meeting Master
effect: The first allied Follower with "Maid" in the name is deactivated. The first allied Follower with "Lady" in the name gets ATK/STA increased by the deactivated Follower's SIZE.
flavortext: [From today forth, I will be your master. Are you excited about our future together?]

title: Messenger Knight
name: Messenger Knight
flavortext: [I just need to deliver this letter to the Empire, right? Hah! Piece of cake! It's going to be just dandy... I'll be back soon, Miss Jaina.]

title: Meteor Call
name: Meteor Call
effect: All enemy Followers get their STA decreased by the number of Followers in both Fields, and all allied Followers get their STA decreased by the number of enemy Followers.
flavortext: [Stars. Flame. The time has come for ruin to visit this land. Heavens... Fall!]

title: Meteor Call Lady
name: Meteor Call Lady
effect: Before this card attacks, a random enemy Follower gets its STA decreased by 1 plus the number of allied cards with "Lady" in the name. Next, this skill is removed until the start of the next turn.
flavortext: [What do I burn next?]

title: Midnight Doll Show
name: Midnight Doll Show
effect: If there are at least seven Darklore Followers in your Grave, all enemy Followers get DEF -2/STA -2.
flavortext: [None of my dolls are failures. They're all facets of myself.]

title: Military Knight Sillit
name: Military Knight Sillit
flavortext: [Is anyone injured? Let's take a break. The injured should wait here, then come with the second wave!]

title: Minds in Conflict
name: Minds in Conflict
effect: The first allied Follower with a skill and the first enemy Follower with a skill get their SIZE, ATK, DEF, STA, and skills swapped.
flavortext: [Nanai!] [You don't deserve to be president, Celine. That position belongs to me.]

title: Miracle Panda Panica
name: Miracle Panda Panica
effect: At the start of the turn, if the Turn Number is odd, two random allied Followers get ATK +1. If the Turn Number is even, a random allied Follower gets STA +2.
flavortext: [I'm only going to go with you for a little while! It's not because I like you or anything! I'm only moving in because I have to!]
notes:
Reward for beating [[Bamboo Garden]] 10 times
See also: [[Cinia's Pet Panica]]

title: Miscalculation
name: Miscalculation
effect: If your Hand contains three or fewer cards, Followers are sent from the top of your Deck to your Hand until there are four cards in your Hand.
flavortext: [Why does this same mistake keep getting made? Our predecessors made the mistake, and now their replacements are making the same mistake! What will we do if the mistake just keeps getting passed down?]

title: Mischief
name: Mischief
effect: All enemy Followers get their STA decreased by three times the number of cards in your Grave named "Mischief".
flavortext: [Th-this joke went too far!] [So what? It's just a joke.]

title: Misfit
name: Misfit
effect: Enemy Followers with a combined ATK/STA of at least 22 get ATK/STA changed to equal your Field SIZE. If you have a Darklore Character, their ATK/STA is changed to equal half of your Field SIZE (rounding down) instead.
flavortext: [Cannelle was born in the wild. As a child of nature, she couldn't adjust to a life stuck in a mansion. "I want to go back..."]

title: Misfortune
name: Misfortune
effect: Six Spells in your Grave are removed from the game. If this happens, a random enemy Follower gets SIZE +3.
flavortext: [K-Kana... wasn’t just... a place.] [You have learned too much. Kana is something that must be guarded. Do not approach it so carelessly.]

title: Moondancer Kata Flina
name: Moondancer Kata Flina
effect: At the start of the turn, two random enemy Followers get ATK -1/STA -1.
flavortext: [Do you see the eyes of the audience blinking in the pale moonlight? Don't you want to have a try? You'll be a great stage prop. Well, your blood will. Hee hee.]
notes: [[:File:Moon Dance Kata Flina.jpg|Previous Image]]

title: Mop Maid
name: Mop Maid
effect: Before this card is attacked, this card and adjacent Followers get ATK +1.
flavortext: [How much longer do I have to mop? I wish the kohai would get here soon... Like that's going to happen... Maybe.]

title: Morals Crackdown
name: Morals Crackdown
effect: If there are any allied Followers, then all allied and enemy Followers get DEF =0 and get STA decreased by the total change in DEF.
flavortext: [A human life is deeper than the ocean. A human's love is higher than the mountains. To those who don't understand this, look to tomorrow and see! Emergency! Target point 4 8 5! Geo Scud Launch, Go!]

title: Morning Cinia
name: Morning Cinia
effect: At the start of the turn, a random allied Follower gets ATK +1/STA +1. Next, if the enemy Character is an NPC, a secret bonus skill activates.
flavortext: [ I always feel like someone strange is watching me when I open my eyes in the morning. Her eyes are closed, and her feelings are hidden as she whispers. I wonder. "Those eyes... Whose are they?"]
notes:
The secret bonus skill is a 0-2 ATK/STA bonus to the same follower who received the first bonus.
This card is no longer craftable.

title: Morning Iri
name: Morning Iri
effect: At the start of the turn, a random allied Follower gets ATK +1/STA +1. Next, if the enemy Character is an NPC, a secret bonus skill activates.
flavortext: [The office is always noisy in the morning. Those two vampire kids never sleep. They're always causing a racket, and Esprit is always yelling at them. Their constant attempts to transform always ends with the sound of Esprit's slippers hitting them.]
notes:
The secret bonus skill is a 0-2 ATK/STA bonus to the same follower who received the first bonus.
This card is no longer craftable.

title: Morning Luthica
name: Morning Luthica
effect: At the start of the turn, a random allied Follower gets ATK +1/STA +1. If in a dungeon match, a secret bonus skill activates.
flavortext: [ I had a nightmare at the start of the day. I don't remember how I got here, but I always suffer in loneliness.]
notes:
The secret bonus skill is a 0-2 ATK/STA bonus to the same follower who received the first bonus.
This card is no longer craftable.

title: Morning Sita
name: Morning Sita
effect: At the start of the turn, a random allied Follower gets ATK +1/STA +1. Next, if the enemy Character is an NPC, a secret bonus skill activates.
flavortext: [I woke up to bright sunlight. Everything was a blur. Maybe it was the light? I toss and turn under the sun.] [Did you sleep well?] [A familiar voice called out, but there was nothing. Maybe I'm just hearing things.]
notes:
The secret bonus skill is a 0-2 ATK/STA bonus to the same follower who received the first bonus.
This card is no longer craftable.

title: Mother Demon Rumor
name: Mother Demon Rumor
effect: If the total SIZE of enemy cards in Slot 1 and 2 is at least 6, the enemy card in Slot 2 is destroyed.
flavortext: [Welcome, my future friends! The mother of all darkness, the Mother Demon, is making her return. Aren't you interested? Why am I calling you a friend? You haven't died yet? Well, you'll all die someday.]

title: New Cook Club Student
name: New Cook Club Student
effect: At the start of the turn, a random allied Follower with "Cook Club" in the name gets ATK +1/STA +1.
flavortext: [Excuse me... Huh? Are those cookies I smell? Isn't this the Cooking Club?]

title: New Knight
name: New Knight
flavortext: [I will gladly fight alongside the senpai knights! Just help me out if I get into trouble. This sword? It was given to me by someone I respect a lot. I love this sword as if it were a part of my own body.]

title: New Knight (Character)
name: New Knight
effect: At the start of the turn, enemy Followers in Slots 1, 2, and 3 get STA -1.
flavortext: [Do some special training with me! Follow me. I'll lead you to a secret training ground.]

title: New Lib. Student
name: New Lib. Student
flavortext: [I found all the books that senpai recommended, but... What is she playing at? They really loaned out those books?]

title: New Maid
name: New Maid
flavortext: [Excuse me, senpai? How should I clean this? Wow... This vase looks expensive.]

title: New Maid Training
name: New Maid Training
effect: Two random allied Academy Followers get ATK +2/STA +2.
flavortext: [Your first task is to learn the layout of the building. Understood?] [Yes, senpai!]

title: New Recipe
name: New Recipe
effect: Your Character's LIFE is increased by the difference between 10 and your Field's SIZE (to a maximum of 5).
flavortext: [Everyone else can only make cookies... Well, I will cook something new!]

title: Newbie Guide Rico
name: Newbie Guide Rico
flavortext: [It's good to rest when you're tired, but don't forget the enthusiasm you had when you started.]

title: Night Conqueror
name: Night Conqueror
effect: If you have a Darklore Character, enemy Followers with a SIZE of 3-5, as well as allied non-Darklore Followers, are sent to the owners' Graves.
flavortext: [Tell me where the head of the Flina family is. In the meantime, I'm taking all the blood you have to drink... Hee hee hee.]

title: Night's Beckoning
name: Night's Beckoning
effect: If you have at least one Vita Follower and at least one non-Vita Follower in your Grave, all enemy Spells are sent to the Grave. If there are no enemy Spells, this card is deactivated instead of being sent to the Grave.
flavortext: [Sita, come here... I can't bear this any longer... Be with me... I want to carve everything about me into those golden apples you have for eyes... Sounds delicious... I want to know everything about you, Sita... Give yourself to me.]

title: No Turning Back
name: No Turning Back
effect: If there are any allied Followers, and if the enemy Field SIZE is odd, a random enemy Follower is destroyed. If the enemy Field SIZE is even, a random allied Follower is sent to the Grave.
flavortext: [Hold your swords! A Crux Knight is always ready for a glorious death!]

title: Noble Sacrifice
name: Noble Sacrifice
effect: The allied Academy Follower with the highest SIZE is sent to the Grave, and then your Character has its LIFE increased by twice that card's SIZE.
flavortext: [Who will bell the cat? To place Cinia's shoes upon her feet is an essential display of respect from her maids.]

title: Nold
name: Nold
effect: At the start of the turn, a random card in your Hand gets SIZE +1. If this happens, a random allied card gets SIZE -1 (to a minimum of 1).
flavortext: [The other students will be really shocked to see you like this in the school.] [My looks were designed with them in mind.]
notes:
Reward for beating [[Beginner Dungeon]] 10 times
See also: [[Nold, The Gold Lion]]
history: Update 2.2.2: Name changed from Gold Lion Nold to Nold.

title: Nytitch
name: Nytitch
effect: At the start of the turn, a random enemy Follower gets ATK -1/STA -1.
flavortext: [Long time no see! Did you have a good sleep? You go out every night, so I'm always lonely. Play with me!]

title: Obedience
name: Obedience
effect: If you have an Academy Character, a random enemy Follower with a SIZE of 4 or less gets SIZE +2. If the Follower’s new SIZE is at least 5, it gets STA -3.
flavortext: [D-Don't think I'm easy to win over! I'm only going to your house so I can conquer it... Whatever. Let's go.]

title: Occult Club Iris Juvia
name: Occult Club Iris Juvia
flavortext: [I met with an interesting friend by the name of Elfin.] [Who is that?] [She can make dolls that actually have souls.]

title: Occult Club Rebecca
name: Occult Club Rebecca
flavortext: [The monthly discussion isn't over yet? How about settling on just one main topic and focusing on only solving that?]

title: Occult Lady Aimi
name: Occult Club Aimi
flavortext: [Interesting. I'd like to meet her myself and see what kind of person she is. Iris, will you introduce me?]

title: Office Chief Esprit
name: Office Chief Esprit
effect: At the start of the turn, one of the following effects is applied depending on the number of skills in your Field: ● 2 or less: A random enemy Follower's skills are removed. ● More than 2: A random allied Follower gets ATK/STA increased by half of the number of skills in your Field (rounding up).
flavortext: [1E! 2D! 3A! 4P! 5G!] [I'll chase you to the end of the galaxy! Just try and run! I'll chase you until your very souls sweat and bleed!]
notes: Reward for beating [[Dream Island]] 10 times

title: Office Witch
name: Office WItch
effect: Before this card attacks, if the number of enemy cards is even, a random card in the enemy Hand is sent to the Grave. Next, this skill is removed.
flavortext: [Got it! So I'll see you in the lobby this afternoon? What? You aren't done yet? This was assigned to you last Monday! What do you expect me to do about it now?]

title: Omnivore
name: Omnivore
effect: Two random allied Followers have their STA increased by the number of different SIZES in your Hand +1.
flavortext: [This isn't bad...] [Uh... That's supposed to be for animals.]

title: One Way Trip
name: One Way Trip
effect: All allied Followers get one or more of the following effects for each allied Follower that meets the following conditions (Each effect stacks.): ● Cook Club: SIZE -1/STA +1 ● Lib.: ATK +1/STA +1 ● Council: DEF +1/STA +1 ● Other Vita Followers: ATK +1/DEF +1
flavortext: [As long as I know this, I can't pretend to know nothing. Be warned, Nanai.] [Whatever.]

title: Opera Doll
name: Opera Doll
flavortext: [The second doll is doomed to have a sad story, but in joy. A story of a woman who wasted her life in pointless pleasure.]

title: Over the Wall
name: Over the Wall
effect: The first allied Vita Follower is moved to Slot 5 and has its ATK/STA increased by the combined SIZE of cards in Slots 2 and 4.
flavortext: [The whole world is waiting for me beyond this wall! I'll be back, Asmis!]

title: Overwhelm
name: Overwhelm
effect: Enemy Followers with a combined DEF/STA that are higher than the enemy Character's LIFE get DEF decreased by half of the enemy Character's LIFE (rounding down).
flavortext: [Go screw yourself... Get out of my way. Stop dripping that disgusting rotten blood and just go away.]

title: Pacifism
name: Pacifism
effect: All allied and enemy Followers are deactivated. All allied Crux Followers get SIZE -1.
flavortext: [Still, it's best to have peace, isn't it?]

title: Pass the Blood
name: Pass the Blood
effect: An allied Darklore Follower in Slot 3 gets ATK/STA increased by the total DEF of all allied Followers.
flavortext: [Heh... Would you like a drink?]

title: Passcode
name: Passcode
effect: If there are at least three cards in your Field with the same SIZE, Followers in your Field with that SIZE get ATK +3/STA +3.
flavortext: [Oh, welcome. If you tell me the right number, I'll send you on your way.]

title: Peace Lady
name: Peace Lady
effect: Before this card attacks, a random card in your hand with "Maid" in the name is sent to the top of your Deck. If this happens, this card gets ATK +1/STA +2.
flavortext: [Miss Linia's maids are all so pure and proper. Ah... They're cute, too. I wish I could have just one maid like that.]

title: Perky Girl
name: Perky Girl
effect: The first two cards in your Deck with "Sita" in the name are sent to the first two empty Slots in your Hand. If this happens, those cards get SIZE -2.
flavortext: [The artifact that Esprit found had amazing effects. It could reverse a person's personality. Sita, for example, became perky.]

title: Picnic Lady
name: Picnic Lady
flavortext: [Hm? Oh, no. It's delicious. I just wish that we could have more chances to do this in the future.]

title: Picnic Maid
name: Picnic Maid
effect: Before this card is attacked, a random enemy Follower gets its STA decreased by the number of cards in your Hand with "Maid" or "Lady" in the name. If this happens, this skill is removed until the start of the next turn.
flavortext: [I'm happy that you liked the food I prepared, Miss Cinia. Please allow me to cook for you next time as well.]

title: Pilgrimage Of Proof
name: Pilgrimage Of Proof
effect: If there are any allied Followers, two random enemy Followers get DEF decreased by 4 minus this card's SIZE. Next, if this card has a SIZE of 1, it is removed from the game. If it has a SIZE of at least 2, it gets SIZE -1 and is deactivated.
flavortext: "I need to find myself," said Sergeant Pintail. To find her own path, she took fourteen nights and fifteen days off. Her destination was H.K.]

title: Planned Misfortune
name: Planned Misfortune
effect: Allied Followers with a SIZE equal to or greater than the SIZE of the enemy Follower with the lowest SIZE get ATK +1/DEF +1/STA +1.
flavortext: [Linia, these days, I have been feeling strange. I feel that the decisions I make are not my own. Something is eating away at me, as if someone were emerging from inside my consciousness.]

title: Pleased to Meet You
name: Pleased to Meet You
effect: All allied and enemy Followers get STA +1.
flavortext: [I don't expect you to understand why I went through the trouble to sneak in here to just to say this, but I'm... pleased to meet you...]
notes: This card is only obtainable from the Deluxe Starter Set.

title: Porter Maid
name: Porter Maid
flavortext: [Miss Cinia, where are you going? I will escort you! For an otaku maid like me, there's nothing more exciting than going out with my master!]

title: Power Control
name: Power Control
effect: If there are any allied Crux Followers with "Seeker" in the name and any allied Crux Followers without "Seeker" in the name, two random allied Crux Followers get ATK+3/STA+3.
flavortext: [The director's ultimate artifact. It's more powerful than anything ever before. The ability to control that power is one of the director's greatest skills.]

title: Prank's Price
name: Prank's Price
effect: The first two cards in your Hand and the enemy Hand are sent to the Grave. (No effect if neither Hand has enough cards.)
flavortext: [Really... I told you not to drag me into your tasteless jokes!]

title: Prefect Layna
name: Prefect Layna
effect: Before this card is attacked, it has its STA increased by the number of cards in your Hand +1.
flavortext: [You there! Watch how you move! Don't mess up your skirt! Just look at how you're presenting yourself!]

title: Preserver of Rules
name: Preserver of Rules
effect: A random allied Vita Follower gets ATK increased by 1 plus the number of cards in your Hand and gets STA increased by the number of cards in your Hand minus 1.
flavortext: [The inspector loves peace, believes in friendship, and wishes to protect peoples' lives, so she stands against rule breakers as an extracurricular activity.]

title: Priestess
name: Priestess
effect: Before this card is attacked, your Character gets LIFE +1.
flavortext: [Belief in a single thing brings everyone together. So please, don't lose faith in your beliefs.]

title: Principal's Story
name: Principal's Story
effect: The first card in the enemy Hand that does not belong to the enemy Character's faction is sent to the first empty Slot in your Hand.
flavortext: [The visitor was a man in red. I don't know what "Kana" was, but he was looking for the same thing you were. He seemed anxious. He was also carrying another "key."]

title: Private Maid
name: Private Maid
effect: At the start of the turn, a random enemy Follower gets ATK -1.
flavortext: [Might I ask why I was hired differently from those personal maids, Lady Rosa...?] [I just had somewhere to go and needed someone to go with me. That's all.]

title: Proof of Miracles
name: Proof of Miracles
effect: Your Character gets LIFE decreased by half of the number of cards in your Hand (rounding down). If this happens, a random allied Crux Follower gets ATK/STA increased by the number of cards in your Hand.
flavortext: [This is something that can cut through the invisible link between cause and effect. Isn't this sickle the proof of the ancient visitors' victory?]

title: Protective Chant
name: Protective Chant
effect: Allied Followers with a SIZE equal to the number of allied Followers get ATK +3/STA +3.
flavortext: [The flash of a shield protects the will of the knights!]

title: Pupil Becomes Master
name: Pupil Becomes Master
effect: All enemy Followers get STA decreased by the Turn Number divided by the number of enemy cards (rounding down).
flavortext: [Now I understand... This is blood? Hee hee.. Looks delicious. It's sweet. Hahaha...]

title: Pursuit of Perfection
name: Pursuit of Perfection
effect: Allied Academy Followers that have a SIZE of 2 or less get ATK =1/STA =1. The first Academy Follower in your Hand gets ATK increased by half of the total ATK reduction (rounding up) and STA increased by half of the total STA reduction (rounding up).
